issue.title: Render Mermaid diagrams as vector figures in bob ref create PDFs
issue.description: Explicit Mermaid code blocks in Markdown and vault-note imports print as fitted, selectable, Highlights-safe vector figures instead of wrapped source. payload.entry:
ATHENA acceptance, 2026-10-17. Read `research:202610/merge_queue_fence_reassessment_explained.md` through its audited artifact ref (`file:explicit:20a31b0e7cfdc185f9d9a11c`) and imported the 12-fence report into a temporary vault with the workspace `cargo run --bin bob`; no real vault was touched. Warm paired imports with a TMPDIR path over 40 bytes: rendering disabled 5.66 s / 16 pages; rendering enabled 10.37 s / 21 pages, a +4.70 s delta for the 12-diagram batch. All 12 rendered. A source path with spaces and Japanese characters passed; 5 representative body-text checks passed and no Mermaid source leaked. Scale warnings: diagram 3 at 46%, diagram 5 at 49%. The separate first run took 52.88 s including the initial cargo build.
